title: Supporting a Friend Through Depression
paragraphs: Ketika teman dekatnya mulai menarik diri dari pertemuan sosial dan tampak terus-menerus murung, Hamid tidak yakin bagaimana membantunya, khawatir mengatakan hal yang salah dan memperburuk situasi. Alih-alih memberikan nasihat cepat atau mendesaknya untuk segera merasa lebih baik, Hamid mulai berkunjung secara rutin, duduk dengan tenang bersama temannya bahkan saat percakapan terasa sulit atau minim.

Selama beberapa minggu, temannya akhirnya mulai lebih terbuka, kemudian mengakui bahwa kehadiran Hamid yang stabil dan sabar lebih berarti daripada kata-kata spesifik apa pun yang bisa ia tawarkan selama kunjungan itu. Hamid belajar bahwa mendukung seseorang melewati masa kesehatan mental yang sulit terkadang berarti sekadar hadir secara konsisten, alih-alih mencoba memperbaiki masalah itu segera.
answerKey: When his close friend began withdrawing from social gatherings and seemed persistently low, Hamid was not sure how to help, worried about saying the wrong thing and making the situation worse. Rather than offering quick advice or pushing him to simply feel better, Hamid started visiting regularly, sitting quietly with his friend even when conversation felt difficult or minimal. Over several weeks, his friend eventually opened up more, later admitting that Hamid's steady, patient presence mattered more than any specific words he could have offered during those visits. Hamid learned that supporting someone through a difficult mental health period sometimes meant simply showing up consistently, rather than trying to fix the problem immediately.
